reason: Every measurement checks out when driven in chromium (?v=light&state=full, reduced motion, boxes read after entrance settles). 1440 and 1280: .kpi.lead is 204x156.6, identical to a sibling, area ratio 1.00, widest ink run 98.3px = 57.2% of the 172px inner width (seat said 57.1%). At 900 the row goes 366px/366px and the lead takes grid-column: 1 / -1 at lately.html:556: 748x125.5, ink still 98.3px = 13.7% of a 716px inner width, area 1.88x a sibling. 768: 616x125.5, 16.8%, 1.89x (seat said 1.88 - rounding). 560: 512x125.5, 20.5%, 1.90x. 390: 342x125.5, 31.7%, 1.68x. The child boxes are unchanged across the breakpoint - t-label 20px, t-num 35.4px, t-small 20.1px - confirming the seat's actual claim: nothing composed the banner, grid-column: 1 / -1 stretched a portrait tile. Screenshotting .kpis at 768 and 390 confirms the perceptual half too: it is the only solid-ink object in the band and it is five-sixths empty, with the label, the 9 and the phrase hugging the left edge of a 748px plate. This is not a restatement of a gate: the kpi-row assertions at interaction-check.mjs:709-724 run only at 1280 and 1440 (the seat's line cite is 2 lines off, the substance is right), and nothing in either gate measures the lead card's proportions below 900. It is not on the already-fixed or already-refuted lists, touches no locked constraint (no colour, no weight, no metric, no architecture), and leaves the shared-denominator contract intact - same 9, same card, same row, first in reading order. I applied the proposed CSS via addStyleTag and re-measured: the plate drops to 748x69.4 / 616x69.4 / 512x69.4 / 342x69.4, area ratio 1.04 at 900 and 768, 1.05 at 560, 0.93 at 390 (0.96/0.86 in partial, where the unavailable card is taller). 'OPEN NOW 9 jobs not finished' sets on one baseline-aligned line at every width down to 320 with no overflow and no document scrollWidth growth, and with a forced 3-digit denominator at 320 it wraps to 81.7px rather than spilling. The loading skeleton follows automatically - it is the real composition (movementTwo() inside .sk-wrap at lately.html:1026) - so the skeleton lead measures 69.4 against the real 69.4 and the '@ 390' height assertion at interaction-check.mjs:386 still passes. Seat's post-fix estimate of 66px is 3.4px light; immaterial. The one part of the finding I do not accept is the word 'inverts' in the consequence: the denominator is the first and only solid-ink object at 1440 too, so what changes below 900 is weight, not order. Correcting that does not save the plate - the composition genuinely does not match its box. Severity corrected up from refinement to defect: 'refinement' in this brief means nothing is wrong, and something is measurably wrong here at the three widths the audience uses most. It is not misleading - the plate asserts nothing untrue, it just outweighs the four counts the movement exists to deliver.
sharpenedFix: Take the seat's fix with one change and one addition, inside the existing @media (max-width: 900px) block next to .kpi.lead { grid-column: 1 / -1 }: .kpi.lead { flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--gap-snug); flex-wrap: wrap; } .kpi.lead > .t-label { height: auto; } .kpi.lead > .t-small { flex: 0 1 auto; }. Use flex: 0 1 auto, not the proposed 0 0 auto - the goal is only to stop .t-small inheriting the grow from .kpi > .t-small { flex: 1 1 auto } at lately.html:347, and flex-shrink: 0 additionally forbids the phrase from ever compressing, which is the wrong guarantee for a fixture-driven line whose denominator can reach three digits. flex-wrap: wrap makes the overflow behaviour explicit rather than relying on Chromium's automatic-minimum-size rescue that I observed at 320px. Everything else in the seat's proposal is correct as written, including keeping display: flex on .t-label so its baseline still resolves.
breaks: Nothing in either gate as far as I could drive it, but four things to re-measure after it lands. (2) interaction-check.mjs:709-724 must stay green unchanged; the media query stops at 900 so 1280 and 1440 are untouched, but confirm rather than assume. (3) Run audit.mjs after: the change is layout-only and introduces no colour, hue, family or weight, but the leading and type-ramp checks now see .t-label at height: auto rather than a pinned 20px box. Also re-shoot ?state=partial at 390, where the sibling column is tallest (168.5px) and the fixed banner drops the lead to 0.86x a sibling - the least flattering ratio the fix produces, though still far better than 1.68x. ?state=quiet renders no .kpi row at all, so it is unaffected.
